source.name: FIA Formula E - Max Gunther joins forces with Paysafe Envision Racing for 2026/27 Formula E season (new Title Partner, team rebrand)
source.note: Announcement says the British squad 'welcomes a new Title Partner'; team now 'Paysafe Envision Formula E Team'. Placement front is the site's mapping of team title/name, following the MotoGP precedent.
